title: KU team plans US network for high-quality reference genome sequencing
summary_en: Investigators from the University of Kansas — where genomics are prioritized as a research focus — are making detailed plans for a national reference genome infrastructure with support from the National Science Foundation.
title_cn: KU team plans US network for high-quality reference genome sequencing

title: KU to celebrate first-generation Jayhawks at I Am First Too poster unveiling
summary_en: Twelve KU students, faculty, staff and alumni who were the first in their families to attend college will be honored at the I Am First Too Poster Unveiling Celebration from 3 to 4:30 p.m. Nov. 9 in the Kansas Union Ballroom. The Center for Educational Opportunity Programs hosts the event, which will feature a keynote address by Melissa Peterson.
title_cn: KU to celebrate first-generation Jayhawks at I Am First Too poster unveiling
